analysis.title: DeskTalk - US equity check: Meta's moment
key_insights: Risk appetite improved through the session, with SPX +0.7% and NDX +1.3%, as investors returned to the AI trade after SpaceX (+7%) earnings reinforced confidence in the AI capex cycle.
The rally is narrow beneath the surface: market breadth is weak and volumes are mostly subdued. SPX is about 1% below its all-time high set Oct 6.
Sector performance is selective. Info tech and industrials lead, while defensives, healthcare and consumer discretionary lag.
Vol eased after an orderly VIX expiry, but elevated skew points to persistent demand for downside protection, particularly in late-October expiries, with notable put spread buying in both SPX and ES.

In credit, HY outperformance versus IG is waning as investors price in continued debt-funded AI investment. Quant flows favor HY risk selling. Treasury vol has eased modestly, which supports risk assets, and flows show hedge fund short covering.

Meta reports at 16:30 ET and is viewed as the next major test of the AI narrative. Citi analyst Ron Josey expects better-than-consensus revenue and profitability, with the focus on Meta's products and services. Josey recently raised his PT to $895 from $800.

market_movers.rationale: Ron Josey recently raised his PT to $895 from $800 and expects better-than-consensus revenue and profitability ahead of the 16:30 ET earnings report.

sector_views.rationale: Info tech led sector gains as investors returned to the AI trade.
Industrials were among the leading sectors in the session.
Healthcare lagged in the session as defensives underperformed.
Consumer discretionary lagged in the session.

earnings_insights: Meta reports Q3 earnings at 16:30 ET (date of this note), viewed as the next major test of the AI narrative. Citi's Ron Josey expects revenue and profitability above consensus, with the focus on products and services.
SpaceX earnings, reported before this note, were described as blockbuster, and the stock rose 7%. The report says this reignited confidence in the durability of the AI capex cycle.
risk_factors: The rally is narrow, with weak breadth and subdued volumes.
Elevated skew and put spread buying in late-October expiries point to persistent demand for downside protection.
HY outperformance versus IG is waning as investors price in continued debt-funded AI investment.
vol_and_positioning: CTA levels: SPX (ESZ6) is trading above the trigger to flip back to 'max long' at $7,746 (ref $7,804). NDX (NQZ6) has surpassed the 'flip long' and 'max long' level at $29,937 (ref $30,064). A close above these levels suggests systematic funds will increase long exposure into Thursday.
Vol eased after an orderly VIX expiry. Skew remains elevated, pointing to demand for downside protection in late-October expiries, with notable put spread buying across SPX and ES.
Jan. ATM implied vol is broadly unchanged in SPX and modestly firmer in QQQ.
Treasury vol eased modestly. Flows show hedge fund short covering.
